title: Balatro Basics 2: Tips for Early-Mid Antes (Signals, Pivoting, Build Orders)
description:
Balatro Basics Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdNGt-ihEAcEY9VVwmqT4V80xWG9ZWA14 
Balatro Everyday Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q4PPUfrs8jI&list=PLdNGt-ihEAcHeBy6CpppXck5i6PmZ-cau

Made accessible for beginners but deep enough for more experienced players as well. In the second episode of the Balatro Basics series, we focus on the Early to Mid Antes. Once we have our economy online, we have more purchases decisions per shop. Learn how to prioritize your purchases and read the signals from the game about what it wants you to be building. 


(Version 1.0.0n)
